name: Linked sessions
description: Runs of agent teams read as their sessions on one clock: a lane per session with each subagent under the session that spawned it, every tool call a mark coloured by its tool or by the labels, each session's transcript of prompts, calls, waits and returns, and the runs side by side.
data: Three runs of an agent team upgrading one library, each a folder as its harness wrote it: the lead's transcript runs/<run>/<session>.jsonl, each subagent's in runs/<run>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl, and runs/<run>/sessions-index.json naming the team and the agents. A transcript line is user or assistant with a message of text, tool_use and tool_result blocks. The harness changed between runs: timestamps as ISO 8601 with Z, an offset or none, or epoch milliseconds; isError in r1 and is_error later; the Task tool called Agent in r3; index versions 1 and 2. A line is written twice in one session, an index misses a session, and r2's lead transcript ends in a cut-off line the reader reports. Exit codes, permission denials and a Grep's matched files are only in a result's text.
